data.description: Data source and the only fields read

disclaimer.description: Not legal advice; not affiliated with the FMCSA; not a consumer report

enforcement.description: What the FMCSA says it currently enforces: state (suspended), since (first due date explicitly covered), until, applies_to, rule_still_in_force, source_url, source_last_updated, read_on, quote, summary_url, summary_read_on, summary_quote (the FMCSA Resources Hub summary of the notice)

licence.description: Licence of the source data: nom, url, source, attribution (if required)

note.description: PRISM exemption and how to read null values

results.description: One entry per USDOT number: usdot_number, found, usdot_status (active, inactive, pending), state, operation (interstate, intrastate_hazmat, intrastate_non_hazmat), covered_by_390_19T, as_of, time_zone, time_zone_known, filing_month, filing_years (odd, even), parity_assumed, last_deadline, next_deadline, days_to_next_deadline, last_mcs150_update, overdue (true, false, null), overdue_reason, deactivation_exposure (true, false, null), deactivation_exposure_reason, enforcement_for_last_deadline (suspended: due on or after enforcement.since, covered by the FMCSA notice; not_explicitly_covered: due earlier, the notice neither covers nor excludes it explicitly; not_suspended: computed before the notice existed), safer_url

rules.description: Rules applied, with official URL and status
